ui.miniView.alternates.note: Suggests two alternative global shortcuts after the first choice is unavailable. Keep the displayed keyboard chords verbatim.
ui.miniView.alternates.length: One or two lines in Settings.

ui.miniView.context.note: Reports formatted token use without a known context-window total.

ui.miniView.context_estimated.note: Same as context, with an explicit estimate qualifier and no known context-window total.

ui.miniView.context_no_reading.note: No token reading has arrived; this is not an error.

ui.miniView.context_window.note: Reports formatted token use against the model's formatted context-window total.

ui.miniView.context_window_estimated.note: Reports estimated formatted token use against the formatted context-window total.

ui.miniView.control_unavailable.note: A conversation control cannot be presented in the quick-send mini window.

ui.miniView.cwd_read_only.note: Explains why the directory control is read-only: quick send inherits the conversation directory.

ui.miniView.hint.note: Resting composer hint. Enter, Shift+Enter and Esc are key names and stay verbatim.

ui.miniView.hotkey_needs_modifier.note: Rejects a global shortcut without a modifier because it would interfere with typing.
ui.miniView.hotkey_needs_modifier.length: One sentence beneath the shortcut field.

ui.miniView.keep_text.note: A pre-admission failure preserved the user's draft; pair with the refusal rather than implying delivery.

ui.miniView.macos_detection_boundary.note: macOS cannot always identify the application owning a chord. Do not claim the registration definitely failed.
ui.miniView.macos_detection_boundary.length: One sentence beneath the shortcut field.

ui.miniView.placeholder.note: Addresses the resolved seat by its display name.

placeholders.name: Resolved seat display name; preserve user-provided spelling.

ui.miniView.post_admission.note: Delivery is uncertain after admission; direct the user to inspect the conversation rather than retrying and possibly duplicating the message.

placeholders.name: Resolved seat display name; preserve user-provided spelling.

ui.miniView.prior_art_editors.note: Warns about common uses of a chord in editors and word processors. Parameter hints and non-breaking space are technical function names.
ui.miniView.prior_art_editors.length: One sentence beneath the shortcut field.

ui.miniView.prior_art_launchers_mac.note: Fantastical, Things Quick Entry and Control+Option+Space are proper names/a keyboard chord; keep them verbatim.
ui.miniView.prior_art_launchers_mac.length: One sentence beneath the shortcut field.

ui.miniView.prior_art_launchers_other.note: Non-macOS warning that similar capture applications may reserve this chord family and allow rebinding.
ui.miniView.prior_art_launchers_other.length: One sentence beneath the shortcut field.

ui.miniView.quick_send_scope.note: Explains that the global quick-send shortcut works without application focus.

ui.miniView.recording.note: Shown while dictation records; the stop control has its own separate accessible label.

ui.miniView.registration_invalid.note: The operating system rejected this key as a global shortcut.

ui.miniView.registration_registered.note: Confirms the registered global shortcut and includes its platform-formatted display spelling.

placeholders.display: Platform-formatted registered keyboard chord; keep verbatim.

ui.miniView.registration_taken.note: Another application may own the chord; offer choosing another without claiming which application owns it.

placeholders.display: Platform-formatted rejected keyboard chord; keep verbatim.

ui.miniView.registration_unavailable.note: Global shortcuts are unsupported on this operating system.

ui.miniView.seat_label.note: Names the resolved seat receiving the quick-send message.

placeholders.name: Resolved seat display name; preserve user-provided spelling.

ui.miniView.seat_missing.note: This build has no seat matching the resolved display name.

placeholders.name: Resolved seat display name; preserve user-provided spelling.

ui.miniView.seat_open_failed.note: The named seat's conversation could not be opened.

placeholders.name: Resolved seat display name; preserve user-provided spelling.

ui.miniView.seat_unreachable.note: The named seat could not be reached; do not imply the message was delivered.

placeholders.name: Resolved seat display name; preserve user-provided spelling.

ui.miniView.sent.note: Momentary status before the mini window hides after sending.

ui.miniView.sheet_effort.note: Title of the reasoning-effort picker; use the glossary term for reasoning effort if specified by the locale.

ui.miniView.sheet_failed.tone: Brief failure with a retry action.
ui.miniView.sheet_failed.note: The model or effort list request failed; pressing the row retries.

ui.miniView.sheet_loading.note: Shown while reading the model or effort list from the backend.

ui.miniView.sheet_model.note: Title of the model picker for the current conversation; model is a glossary term, model IDs remain verbatim.

ui.miniView.sheet_unavailable.note: The connected backend cannot switch the selected setting through quick send.

ui.miniView.switch_failed.note: Lead-in followed by a technical backend error; retain the colon and trailing separation supplied by the caller.
